cover_headline: India's First Bullet Train Revealed: 280 Kmph Test Speed, 557 Passengers, Eight Coaches

end.headline: India's First Bullet Train Revealed: 280 Kmph Test Speed, 557 Passengers, Eight Coaches
end.line: The BEML-built B28 is rated at 280 kmph in testing and 249 kmph in planned service.

facts: Its maximum test speed is 280 kmph; its planned operational speed is 249 kmph
The eight-coach train carries 557 passengers: seven standard-class coaches and one executive-class coach
The B28 is being built by BEML in Bengaluru for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor
